description.value:
Actions 1 minute

Traits Paradise-Touched, divination, exploration

Touch the corpse of a creature that died within the last hour and ask it one question aloud. If its mind reached Paradise, it answers — honestly, in as much detail as it knew, and only about things it knew in life. It may refuse, and the GM decides whether it does; you always learn that it refused rather than being left in silence. A given creature can be asked only one question, ever, by anyone.
